create_tfp_compatible_bijector: create a TFP-compatible bijector wrapper from a Distrax bijector for use in TFP meta-bijectors
forward_event_shape: compute the output event shape of a bijector forward transform using jax eval_shape tracing
inverse_event_shape: compute the output event shape of a bijector inverse transform using jax eval_shape tracing
forward_log_det_jacobian: compute the forward log determinant of the jacobian for a bijector transformation
experimental_compute_density_correction: compute density correction for a dimension-preserving bijector transform with respect to a tangent space
